note: SEO only. Unlike sweet-bomb-or-a-wild.json this manifest carries no gameTitle, theme, notes or facts, because /dragonhoard/ is not published by tools/publish-game-demo.mjs: the game repo's own demo/scripts/build-demo.mjs assembles it, badge and disclosure config included, and the result is copied in here as a directory. So the only thing this site owns for that page is its head, and the only tool that reads this file is tools/seo-head.mjs. Re-run 'node tools/seo-head.mjs --slug dragonhoard' after every rebuild, or the new build lands with no title again.
